name: Houchou-san no Uwasa
source:
I am a knife. I can kill anyone if there is a call for it. But instead I'm only used at the kitchen. In the past I was a kami, and parents were scaring children with my name if kids behaved bad.
Now I am one of the urban legends at school. Call me, and I shall answer the call.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
我是一把刀。只要有需要，我就能杀死任何人。但现在，我只在厨房里被使用。过去，我是神；孩子们行为不好时，父母会用我的名字吓唬他们。
如今，我是学校里的都市传说之一。呼唤我，我就会回应。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
